title: AI cheating, leaked papers and marking errors: how exam protests went global

paragraphs.en: Families with teenagers in education know the private, hidden pain of exam season. But this year, what might have been a summer of quiet family anxiety has erupted in several countries into public unrest.
paragraphs.zh: 家中有青少年在校读书的家庭都知道考试季那种隐秘的、无人知晓的痛苦。但今年，本该是家庭默默焦虑的一个夏天，却在几个国家爆发成了公开的动荡。

paragraphs.en: Exam-related turmoil has led to mass student protests in Mexico after nearly 60,000 university applicants were forced to resit tests amid suspected cheating , while Portugal’s disastrous attempt to digitise school exam marking sparked the country’s worst education crisis in decades.
paragraphs.zh: 考试引发的动荡在墨西哥导致了大规模学生抗议，近6万名大学申请者因涉嫌作弊而被迫重考；而葡萄牙试图将学校考试阅卷数字化的糟糕尝试，则引发了该国数十年来最严重的教育危机。

paragraphs.en: By far the largest and most ground-shaking incident was in India, however, where an exam paper leak affected millions of students and was linked to more than a dozen students taking their own lives. The scandal forced the education minister to resign , and challenged the government’s hold over its 1.4 billion citizens.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，规模最大、震撼程度最深的事件发生在印度：一场试卷泄题影响了数百万学生，并与十多名学生自杀身亡有关。这起丑闻迫使教育部长辞职，并对政府对其14亿公民的掌控构成了挑战。

paragraphs.en: Why does this exam season seem to be particularly tense and volatile? Experts say the growth of AI cheating and attempts by academic institutions to digitise examinations are at the heart of the issue. When coupled with the high stakes of good grades in an increasingly precarious global economy, the result can be explosive.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么这个考试季显得格外紧张和动荡？专家表示，AI作弊的增长以及教育机构将考试数字化的尝试是问题的核心。当这一切与全球日益不稳定的经济中高分带来的高风险交织在一起时，结果可能是爆炸性的。

paragraphs.en: Related: India’s education minister resigns in victory for Cockroach youth movement protests
paragraphs.zh: 相关报道：印度教育部长在“蟑螂”青年运动抗议浪潮中辞职

paragraphs.en: “It would seem that exams are getting more fraught on a global scale,” said Dr Sarah Eaton of the Werklund School of Education at the University of Calgary. “The pressure on young people has absolutely changed.
paragraphs.zh: “看起来考试在全球范围内正变得愈发令人焦虑，”卡尔加里大学沃克伦德教育学院的萨拉·伊顿博士说。“年轻人承受的压力已经彻底改变了。”

paragraphs.en: “We’ve seen the economic situation change around the world in the last decade. And the results of one examination determining a person’s entire future really creates untenable pressure on young people,” said Eaton, a leading expert on academic ethics. “This is a tragedy when young people are dying by suicide because of an examination outcome.”
paragraphs.zh: “过去十年，我们看到世界各地的经济形势发生了变化。而一场考试的结果决定一个人的整个人生，这真的给年轻人带来了难以承受的压力，”研究学术伦理的权威专家伊顿说。“当年轻人因为一场考试的结果而自杀身亡时，这便是一场悲剧。”

paragraphs.en: When a single test can determine a young person’s entire future, cheating is no longer just about individuals but becomes a systematic issue, said Eaton. This is compounded when illicit commercial industries, known as the “education mafia”, exploit student desperation by stealing and then selling exam papers, something that has become widespread in India and elsewhere.
paragraphs.zh: 伊顿说，当一次考试就能决定一个年轻人的整个人生时，作弊就不再只是个人行为，而会变成一个系统性问题。而当被称为“教育黑手党”的非法商业产业利用学生的绝望，窃取并出售试卷时，问题就更加严重——这种做法在印度等地已十分普遍。
